findings: Build recipes mix pinned OpenCV2.4.13.7, abbreviated packaging commits, FFmpeg release/7.1 branch and many shallow default-branch dependency clones. Ubuntu tag and package upgrades are not digest/version locked. Reproducible decoder evidence requires resolved versions, not parent commit alone.

utility step_configure records first git log line for Git package checkout, then pkg_end removes source. This can help artifact provenance but is not full compiler/configuration/input digest or actual test result. No version artifact generated here.

OpenCV build disables highgui, common image format codecs, tests and performance tests; enables fast math and selected SIMD. Previously reviewed cvutil tests use imread/highgui, so availability in this minimal build must be separately established. No build failure asserted without compiling.
AppImage x86_64 flags require x86-64-v3; macOS equivalent lines commented. Build-time processor requirements differ; no runtime dispatch or scalar/SIMD parity measured.
FFmpeg recipe enables shared GPL, dav1d, OpenCL, cuvid and conditional hardware libraries. Presence of build option is not proof of working hardware decoder or image descriptor equivalence.

KImageFormats build selects HEIF/JXR/JXL, conditionally builds external libraries, disables several dependency test suites and includes documented libjxl workaround flags. Upstream comment about crash is unverified historical statement, not reproduced current bug.
Dockerfile.test installs tooling only; no cbird test suite or corpus execution defined in file. Packaging linuxdeploy script runs one dependency test command, which does not qualify cbird matching.

Environment aliases/cross compiler paths, install/removal commands and network recipes treated only as reviewed source. No tools installed, dependencies built, containers started, files deleted or system settings changed.
